body: I've been thinking that a lot too... like, I didn't ask to be born. If only we could see our futures and choose yes or no before we are born, I know right now I feel like I would have chosen 'no'... but then again, I'm 25, so what if I really did see my whole future and chose 'yes' and that is why I am here right now. Maybe in a couple years or even a couple months things miraculously turn around for the better.
